sentences.en: I interviewed eight dentists and the majority of them, I think six out of eight, first thing out of their mouths.
sentences.zh: 我采访过八位牙医，他们中的大多数人——我想是八分之六吧——一开口就说这个。

sentences.en: I said, what do you want people to know?
sentences.zh: 我问，你们想让大家知道什么？

sentences.en: And they said, don't chew ice.
sentences.zh: 他们就说，不要嚼冰块。

sentences.en: It was overwhelmingly their number one tip.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是他们排名第一的忠告。

sentences.en: Chewing ice is notorious for causing, as you mentioned, small chips in your tooth enamel, the outer layer of your tooth.
sentences.zh: 正如你所提到的，嚼冰块出了名地容易导致牙釉质（牙齿外层）出现细小崩裂。

sentences.en: And these chips can develop into larger cracks that may require treatments like root canals, crowns, even surgical removal of the tooth.
sentences.zh: 而这些崩裂可能会恶化成更大的裂纹，进而需要根管治疗、牙冠甚至是拔牙等手术治疗。

sentences.en: There's a terrifying phrase, right?
sentences.zh: 听起来挺吓人的，对吧？

sentences.en: And this all comes from chewing ice, which so many people do.
sentences.zh: 而这一切都源于嚼冰块，偏偏有这么多人喜欢这么做。

sentences.en: Okay, what else do you have?
sentences.zh: 好吧，还有什么？

sentences.en: This is about decluttering.
sentences.zh: 这条是关于断舍离的。

sentences.en: Always a hit in the early part of the year.
sentences.zh: 这在年初总是很受欢迎。

sentences.en: Let go of that dusty box or bag of mystery chargers and cords.
sentences.zh: 扔掉那一盒或那一袋积了灰的、各种不知名充电器和电线吧。

sentences.en: We all have it.
sentences.zh: 我们每个人都有这东西。

sentences.en: Oh my God, I feel seen.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我觉得被戳中了。

sentences.en: Let it out.
sentences.zh: 说出来吧。

sentences.en: How so?
sentences.zh: 怎么说？

sentences.en: That bag is the most ridiculous bag of cords.
sentences.zh: 那一袋电线简直荒谬至极。

sentences.en: Do you ever subtract from the bag?
sentences.zh: 你从来不会从里面拿走什么吗？

sentences.en: That's what a couple of the experts said to me.
sentences.zh: 有些专家就是这么对说的。

sentences.en: Or do you just add to it?
sentences.zh: 还是说你只会不断往里加？

sentences.en: Does it just get bigger and bigger?
sentences.zh: 它是不是变得越来越大？

sentences.en: Well, I always think like, well, I'm going to need these things or someone's going to need a cord.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我总是想着，呃，我以后会需要这些东西，或者别人会需要一根线。

sentences.en: You know, I don't want to be caught without a cord.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我可不想急用时却找不到充电线。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So it's cords, it's chargers, it's remote controls from the Clinton administration.
sentences.zh: 所以里面全是电线、充电器，还有克林顿政府时期的遥控器。

sentences.en: It's a bag of obsolete technology.
sentences.zh: 这就是一整袋被淘汰的技术垃圾。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And we have no idea what any of those cords are for, but we are very, very afraid to throw them out.
sentences.zh: 我们根本不知道这些电线到底是干什么用的，但我们又极其害怕把它们扔掉。

sentences.en: So I should just throw this bag away.
sentences.zh: 所以我应该直接把这袋东西扔了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Well, first, separate everything into piles and think of all the things in your house that have cords or chargers.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，把所有东西分类堆好，想想你家里有哪些东西是需要电线或充电器的。

sentences.en: Go through and try them.
sentences.zh: 逐个检查并试用一下。

sentences.en: If they don't work, it's likely that they don't.
sentences.zh: 如果它们不能用了，那大概率就是彻底坏了。

sentences.en: I don't want to be presumptuous.
sentences.zh: 我可不想妄下结论。

sentences.en: Then it's time to drop them off at a place that accepts electronic waste.
sentences.zh: 然后就可以把它们送到接收电子垃圾的地方去了。

sentences.en: Nice.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: What's next?
sentences.zh: 接下来是什么？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I love this one.
sentences.zh: 我超喜欢这一条。

sentences.en: It's, if you're feeling cynical, take 15 minutes and collect moments of moral beauty.
sentences.zh: 内容是：如果你感到愤世嫉俗，不妨花15分钟去搜集生活中的道德之美。

sentences.en: Moral beauty.
sentences.zh: 道德之美。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Tell me what moral beauty is.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲什么是道德之美。

sentences.en: That is a concept that was created by a researcher named Docker Keltner, and he wrote a book called
sentences.zh: 这个概念是由一位名叫达克·凯尔特纳的研究人员提出的，他写过一本书叫

sentences.en: Awe.
sentences.zh: 《惊叹》。

sentences.en: It's basically, you know, if you're losing faith in people, the world, politics, whatever, he says to take 15 minutes out of your day and pay attention to the moments of kindness
sentences.zh: 基本上就是，你知道的，如果你对人、对世界、对政治或其他什么失去了信心，他建议你每天抽出15分钟，去关注身边的

sentences.en: all around you.
sentences.zh: 种种善意。

sentences.en: I mean, it can be the tiniest moment.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这可以是非常微小的时刻。

sentences.en: It can be when you're at a store and you see two people sort of joking around in the checkout line, or when you are in traffic
sentences.zh: 比如你在商店里看到两个人在结账排队时开着玩笑，或者你在路上开车时

sentences.en: and somebody waves you in and you get that little rush of pleasure, like, oh, thanks.
sentences.zh: 有人挥手示意让你并线，然后你心里涌起一阵小小的愉悦，心想：‘哦，谢谢。’

sentences.en: And you hold up your hand, you know, you're like, aw.
sentences.zh: 然后你举起手，你知道的，心里会觉得：‘哇。’

sentences.en: There's a lot of that out there if you pay attention.
sentences.zh: 只要你肯留意，生活中到处都有这样的小事。

sentences.en: And you really only need about 15 minutes and you can collect 10 things.
sentences.zh: 而且你只需要大约15分钟，就能收集到10个这样的瞬间。

sentences.en: And they kind of reset you and remind you that a lot of people are good.
sentences.zh: 它们能让你重新振作，并提醒你其实大多数人都是善良的。

sentences.en: I think that I walk around a lot like a cop looking for social infractions, just like the tiny ways in which people are being rude to one another.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我平时走路就像个专门搜寻社会违规行为的警察，满脑子只想着人们互相之间那些微不足道的无礼举动。

sentences.en: And my antennae are always up for that.
sentences.zh: 我的雷达总是时刻开启捕捉这些。

sentences.en: And so that idea of resetting and reorienting myself, looking for those moments of beauty or where people are being kind and not paying so much attention to these tiny injustices,
sentences.zh: 所以，这种重新调整和校准自己的心态，去寻找那些美好的瞬间、或者人们展现善意的地方，而不是把那么多注意力放在这些小摩擦上，

sentences.en: that seems like a really worthy pursuit.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是一件非常值得去追求的事情。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Even, you know, this morning when I was walking to work and I was in Penn Station and
sentences.zh: 甚至，你知道的，今天早上我步行去上班，走到宾夕法尼亚车站时

sentences.en: someone ahead of me had held the door open with their elbow so they don't get germs, you know, but it's an awkward thing to stick your elbow out like that for somebody.
sentences.zh: 我前面的人用手肘撑着门，好让后面的人过去，这样能避免接触细菌，你知道的，但为了别人把手肘那样伸出来其实挺别扭的。

sentences.en: And I thought, hmm, that's nice.
sentences.zh: 然后我想，嗯，这人真好。

sentences.en: I'd do it without even thinking about it now, kind of record those moments.
sentences.zh: 我现在甚至不用多想就会这么做了，把这些时刻记录下来吧。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: This was really great.
sentences.zh: 这次聊得太棒了。

sentences.en: My pleasure.
sentences.zh: 我的荣幸。

sentences.en: And Happy New Year.
sentences.zh: 祝你新年快乐。

sentences.en: Happy New Year to you.
sentences.zh: 也祝你新年快乐。

sentences.en: We're going to take a little break.
sentences.zh: 我们要休息一会儿。

sentences.en: And when we return, lessons from 20 years of the Times' Modern Love column.
sentences.zh: 休息过后，我们将带来《纽约时报》“现代爱情”专栏20年来的感悟。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》游戏板块“Connections（连连看）”字谜的创作者。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢试图难倒你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责创作“Spelling Bee（拼字比赛）”和“Letterboxd”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到的人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games，今天就开始游玩吧。

sentences.en: 20 years ago, Daniel Jones helped create the Times' Modern Love column.
sentences.zh: 20年前，丹尼尔·琼斯协助创办了《时报》的“现代爱情”专栏。

sentences.en: Every week, Modern Love publishes personal essays on love in all its forMs.
sentences.zh: 每周，“现代爱情”都会发表关于各种形式爱情的个人随笔。

sentences.en: Not just romantic love, but love between parents and children, siblings, love between friends, love that's lost or unrequited.
sentences.zh: 不仅是浪漫的爱情，还有父母与子女之间的爱、手足之情、朋友之间的爱、逝去的爱或单恋。

sentences.en: Dan has read thousands of these love stories.
sentences.zh: 丹读过成千上万个这样的爱情故事。

sentences.en: And today, he's here to tell us what he's learned.
sentences.zh: 今天，他来到这里与我们分享他的心得。

sentences.en: Hi, Dan.
sentences.zh: 嗨，丹。

sentences.en: Hi, Melissa.
sentences.zh: 嗨，梅丽莎。

sentences.en: Good to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: So, Dan, I imagine over all the years of doing this work, your perspective on love has probably changed.
sentences.zh: 那么，丹，我猜在从事这项工作的这些年里，你对爱情的看法可能已经发生了改变。

sentences.en: How has this work changed the way you think about love?
sentences.zh: 这份工作是如何改变你对爱情的看法的？

sentences.en: I get asked that a lot, and I think about it a lot.
sentences.zh: 经常有人问我这个问题，我自己也经常思考。

sentences.en: And I think mostly I've seen in essays, but ones that seem, you know, that are sort of successful
sentences.zh: 我想大部分我在文章中看到的——尤其是那些在故事发展上显得比较成功、

sentences.en: in terms of what happens in them and not, is there's kind of a dividing line between people who continue to open their hearts and those who shut down.
sentences.zh: 或是比较深刻的 essays 背后——那些选择继续敞开心扉的人和那些封闭自己的人之间，存在着一条分界线。

sentences.en: And one is the path to happiness and one is the path to unhappiness and regret.
sentences.zh: 一条通往幸福，而另一条则是通往不幸与遗憾。

sentences.en: And it's not always easy when something ends or when you suffer a real loss.
sentences.zh: 当一段感情结束或者你遭受真正的失去时，要做到这一点并不容易。

sentences.en: And to see people who continue to put themselves out there and say, like, this is my one life.
sentences.zh: 看到那些依然选择勇敢展现自我、并说‘这就是我仅此一次的人生’的人们。

sentences.en: I'm going to make something of it.
sentences.zh: ‘我要活出个人样。’

sentences.en: And, yeah, I admire that.
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，我很钦佩这一点。

sentences.en: And I feel like it's changed my life.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这改变了我的生活。

sentences.en: You published a piece earlier this year about what you've learned from reading and editing all these love stories.
sentences.zh: 今年早些时候你发表了一篇文章，讲述了你从阅读和编辑所有这些爱情故事中学到了什么。

sentences.en: One of the takeaways that stayed with me is the line,
sentences.zh: 其中一个让我久久难忘的观点是这样一句话：

sentences.en: Love is more like a basketball than a vase.
sentences.zh: “爱情更像是一个篮球，而不是一个花瓶。”

sentences.en: Talk about that.
sentences.zh: 聊聊这个吧。

sentences.en: Well, that line comes from an essay by a writer named Thomas Hooven.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这句话出自一位名叫托马斯·霍文的作家的一篇文章。

sentences.en: Actually, I call him a writer, but he's a doctor and was a medical resident.
sentences.zh: 其实，我叫他作家，但他其实是一名医生，曾经是一名住院医师。

sentences.en: And he'd come from a difficult childhood.
sentences.zh: 他有着艰难的童年经历。

sentences.en: His fiancée at the time had similarly come from a difficult childhood.
sentences.zh: 他当时的未婚妻也有着类似的艰难童年。

sentences.en: And they found each other, and their relationship was kind of a refuge from their past family lives and their childhoods.
sentences.zh: 他们遇到了彼此，他们的关系就像是逃离过去家庭生活和童年阴影的避难所。

sentences.en: And he, any kind of conflict they would have was, like, apocalyptically threatening to that love.
sentences.zh: 而且他觉得，他们之间的任何冲突，对这份爱来说都像是毁灭性的威胁。

sentences.en: And his whole concept of love was peace.
sentences.zh: 他关于爱情的全部概念就是风平浪静。

sentences.en: She, perhaps sensing the fragility of that, broke off their engagement just a few weeks before they were to get married.
sentences.zh: 也许是察觉到了这种脆弱，她在他们结婚前几周解除了婚约。

sentences.en: And he was just not long before starting his medical residency.
sentences.zh: 当时离他开始住院医师实习期没多久。

sentences.en: And he went off to this medical residency just devastated.
sentences.zh: 他带着破碎的心去开启了这段住院医师生涯。

sentences.en: And how am I going to get through this?
sentences.zh: 我该怎么熬过去呢？

sentences.en: And it was lonely.
sentences.zh: 那段日子很孤单。

sentences.en: But it turned out to be kind of a boot camp for him in what real love means.
sentences.zh: 但事实证明，这对他来说就像是一场关于真正爱情含义的魔鬼训练营。

sentences.en: And that real love involves conflict and disappointment.
sentences.zh: 真正的爱情包含冲突和失望。

sentences.en: And it has to be able to absorb and hold all of those feelings.
sentences.zh: 它必须能够包容并承受所有这些情感。

sentences.en: It can't just be about peace and comfort.
sentences.zh: 不能只有平静和舒适。

sentences.en: And during his residency, he learns that and comes out the other end of it.
sentences.zh: 在住院实习期间，他学会了这一点，并最终走了出来。

sentences.en: What he says is a more full human being and a better doctor and meets a woman where they are able to have a full relationship that he describes as being more like a basketball than a vase.
sentences.zh: 用他的话说，他变成了一个更完整的人、一个更好的医生，并遇到了一位女性，两人能够建立起一段全面的关系，他将其形容为“更像一个篮球，而不是一个花瓶”。

sentences.en: One is durable and can bounce and can take a beating and a vase is something that breaks the first time you drop it.
sentences.zh: 篮球耐用、经得起弹跳和击打，而花瓶只要你一失手掉在地上就会碎掉。

sentences.en: But it looks beautiful from the outside.
sentences.zh: 但它从外表看起来确实很美。

sentences.en: And it resonated so deeply with me because I felt so similarly to him in my life of wanting to avoid conflict, of feeling like love should not—if you fight,
sentences.zh: 这句话深深地引起了我的共鸣，因为我在生活中和他的感觉太像了，总想逃避冲突，觉得爱情不应该是——如果你吵架了，

sentences.en: that means you're not meant to be together.
sentences.zh: 那就说明你们不适合在一起。

sentences.en: And on the contrary, like,
sentences.zh: 但恰恰相反，

sentences.en: to be able to manage a fight and grow from it and know someone more deeply because of it is one of the main keys to sort of a durable and lasting relationship.
sentences.zh: 能够处理好争吵并从中成长，并因此更深入地了解一个人，才是维系一段持久关系的秘诀之一。

sentences.en: Looking back over the archive, so many of the stories that you publish are about love that doesn't laSt.
sentences.zh: 回顾档案库，你发表的许多故事都是关于那些无法长久的爱情。

sentences.en: They're about breakups, they're about one-night stands, or they're about chance encounters with people that you never see again.
sentences.zh: 它们关于分手、一夜情，或者是与那些再也见不到的人的偶遇。

sentences.en: It's about the loss of love or a very fleeting love more than it's about an enduring love.
sentences.zh: 比起天长地久的爱情，它们更多地关乎爱情的失去或转瞬即逝的爱。

sentences.en: I'd love to talk about what you take away from pieces like that.
sentences.zh: 我很想聊聊你从这些作品中获得了什么感悟。

sentences.en: There's a popular conception that a relationship that ends is a failed relationship.
sentences.zh: 人们普遍认为，一段结束的关系就是一段失败的关系。

sentences.en: And, you know, every relationship can have its value.
sentences.zh: 然而，每一段关系都有其价值。

sentences.en: And to think of something as a failure because it ended, it's not fair and it's not wise and it's not productive and it's not true.
sentences.zh: 因为一段感情结束了就认为它是失败的，这既不公平、不明智，也毫无建设性，而且并非事实。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Maybe it's what, like, movies and fairy tales maybe tell us about what a successful relationship looks like, right?
sentences.zh: 也许这就是电影和童话故事告诉我们的，关于成功恋情应该是什么样的样子吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And I mean, at one point I remember noticing, especially among young people, college students, sophisticated college students,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有一段时间我记得我注意到，特别是在年轻人、大学生、成熟的大学生当中，

sentences.en: they still referred to Disney movies as being their inspiration in a way for what romantic love is, which all those movies end in a wedding, you know?
sentences.zh: 他们仍然把迪士尼电影作为他们对浪漫爱情是什么的一种灵感来源，你知道，所有这些电影最后都是以婚礼告终的？

sentences.en: Like, a wedding is the achievement instead of the beginning of a deepening relationship.
sentences.zh: 就像婚礼是终点，而不是深化关系的开始。

sentences.en: And that's part of that misconcession, these sort of scripts that we seem to play in our lives or that we feel like we need to stick to.
sentences.zh: 这正是那种错误观念的一部分，也就是我们在生活中似乎在扮演的或者觉得需要坚持的某种剧本。

sentences.en: And it's not that, you know?
sentences.zh: 事实并非如此，你知道吗？

sentences.en: It's the beginning of conflict.
sentences.zh: 这是冲突的开始。

sentences.en: It's the beginning of something that is deeper.
sentences.zh: 这是一段更深厚关系的开始。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: My favorite modern love essays tend to be about tiny, quiet moments instead of grand gestures.

sentences.en: He talks about this ritual with his son where they also talk each day about the best moments and the worst moments of their day.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了他和儿子之间的一个仪式，他们每天也会谈论他们这一天中最美好的时刻和最糟糕的时刻。

sentences.en: And one night, he's reading with his son and he's feeling distracted and probably checking his phone and just all of those things where you're not in the moment.
sentences.zh: 有一天晚上，他正和儿子一起读书，他感到心不在焉，可能在查看手机，就是那种你没有活在当下所有表现。

sentences.en: And he says, oh, wait, we forgot to talk about our best moment and worst moment.
sentences.zh: 他说，哦，等等，我们忘了聊聊我们最美好的时刻和最糟糕的时刻了。

sentences.en: What's the best moment of your day?
sentences.zh: 你今天最美好的时刻是什么？

sentences.en: And I started to, I actually started to get teary just thinking about it.

sentences.en: And when I read that, I, you know,

sentences.en: And just that reminder, that small moment of like, this is your life.

sentences.en: My name is Zach Rosen.
sentences.zh: 我叫扎克·罗森。

sentences.en: I'm from Detroit, Michigan.
sentences.zh: 我来自密歇根州底特律。

sentences.en: And I'm currently living in Amsterdam.
sentences.zh: 我目前住在阿姆斯特丹。

sentences.en: The best piece of advice I got this year is from my friend, Daniel Estrin.
sentences.zh: 我今年得到的最好建议来自我的朋友丹尼尔·埃斯特林。

sentences.en: And the advice is this.
sentences.zh: 建议是这样的。

sentences.en: When someone says thank you, just say you're welcome.
sentences.zh: 当别人说谢谢时，只需说不客气。

sentences.en: This is not as easy as it seeMs.
sentences.zh: 这并没有看上去那么容易。

sentences.en: We usually say, oh, no, thank you or no problem.
sentences.zh: 我们通常会说，噢，不，谢谢你，或者没关系。

sentences.en: But when we actually accept a thank you with a you're welcome, I find it deeply satisfying for both parties.
sentences.zh: 但当我们真正用一句不客气来接受感谢时，我发现这对双方来说都非常满足。

sentences.en: And I think it's just a really good practice to accept thanks from someone sincerely.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为真诚地接受别人的感谢真的是一个很好的习惯。

sentences.en: Instead of trying harder, try softer.
sentences.zh: 与其更加努力，不如放软身段。

sentences.en: The best advice I got all year was from a Texan who said, never crouch with spurs on.
sentences.zh: 我整年得到的最好建议来自一个得克萨斯人，他说，永远不要带着马刺蹲下。

sentences.en: What other people think of you is none of your business.
sentences.zh: 别人怎么看你，跟你一点关系都没有。

sentences.en: Surrender to the darkness.
sentences.zh: 向黑暗臣服。

sentences.en: You don't need to know how it's going to turn out.
sentences.zh: 你不需要知道结果会如何。

sentences.en: Hi, this is Dave Brashear in New Orleans, Louisiana.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是路易斯安那州新奥尔良的戴夫·布拉舍。

sentences.en: Best advice I got this year, I had to bury my wife after 40 years of marriage.
sentences.zh: 我今年得到的最好建议，在结婚40年后，我不得不埋葬我的妻子。

sentences.en: And the bedroom has been very difficult.
sentences.zh: 卧室变得非常难熬。

sentences.en: My therapist suggested bring the dog into the bedroom.
sentences.zh: 我的治疗师建议把狗带进卧室。

sentences.en: I'm allergic, so it had to be in his crate.
sentences.zh: 我对狗过敏，所以它必须待在笼子里。

sentences.en: But he's happier.
sentences.zh: 但它更快乐了。

sentences.en: And it's transformed my bedroom into a place I can feel comfortable.
sentences.zh: 这把我的卧室变成了一个让我感到舒适的地方。

sentences.en: My best advice when helping somebody get through chemo was not one day at a time, but five minutes at a time.
sentences.zh: 我帮助别人度过化疗期时得到的最好建议不是一天过一天，而是五分钟过五分钟。

sentences.en: The smartest piece of advice I've gotten is that everything is temporary.
sentences.zh: 我得到的最高明的建议是，一切都是暂时的。

sentences.en: And I hope that applies to the head cult that I have right now.
sentences.zh: 我希望这适用于我现在的重感冒。

sentences.en: But mostly, I hope it applies to how I feel about what happened one day, which was my husband came downstairs at breakfast time and said, I owe you an apology.
sentences.zh: 但最重要的是，我希望这适用于我对某天发生的事情的感受，那天我的丈夫在吃早餐时下楼来说，我欠你一个道歉。

sentences.en: I've treated you badly.
sentences.zh: 我一直对你很不好。

sentences.en: I've been seeing someone else, and I love her, and I want to be with her.
sentences.zh: 我一直在和另一个人交往，我爱她，我想和她在一起。

sentences.en: And he got in his car and drove away, and I haven't seen him since.
sentences.zh: 然后他上车开走了，我再也没见过他。

sentences.en: We've been married for 34 years, and I thought we were both happy, but apparently only one of us was.
sentences.zh: 我们已经结婚34年了，我以为我们俩都很幸福，但显然只有一个人是。

sentences.en: So it turns out that even marriage is temporary.
sentences.zh: 所以事实证明，连婚姻也是暂时的。

sentences.en: But I'm hoping that a whole lot of other things happen that couldn't have happened unless this bad thing happened.
sentences.zh: 但我希望会发生很多其他的事情，而这些事情如果不是这件坏事发生的话是不可能发生的。

sentences.en: I'm Stan Perry in Houston, Texas.
sentences.zh: 我是得克萨斯州休斯顿的斯坦·佩里。

sentences.en: One piece of advice I received in 2024 and that I followed all year is each day keep a list of wins.
sentences.zh: 我在2024年收到并一整年都在遵循的一条建议是，每天记下一份胜利清单。

sentences.en: I'm an attorney, so sometimes it's work-related.
sentences.zh: 我是一名律师，所以有时这与工作有关。

sentences.en: For example, a ruling from a court that was significant for a lawsuit.
sentences.zh: 例如，法院对诉讼具有重大意义的裁决。

sentences.en: Other times, it's something that may not be that significant for my career, but is very significant on a personal level.
sentences.zh: 其他时候，这是一件对我的职业生涯可能没有那么重大，但在个人层面上非常重要的事情。

sentences.en: For example, my parents are in their 80s, and each time I talk to them, I consider it a win, just to be able to hear their voice and talk to them.
sentences.zh: 例如，我的父母都80多岁了，每次我和他们交谈，我都认为这是一场胜利，仅仅是能够听到他们的声音并和他们说话。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Gina Luongo, and I live in Toronto, Canada.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我叫吉娜·龙哥，我住在加拿大安大略省多伦多市。

sentences.en: The best piece of advice I got this year, quite simply, is when you put on your lipstick, use your finger to spread it over your lips.
sentences.zh: 我今年得到的最好建议，简而言之，就是当你涂口红时，用手指把它晕染开。

sentences.en: It gives a very fresh, natural, and pouty look.
sentences.zh: 这会带来一种非常清新、自然和有点小嘟嘴的外观。

sentences.en: And it's what French women do, apparently.

sentences.en: I can't believe it.

sentences.en: It has softened the look of my face while adding some much-needed color.
sentences.zh: 它柔化了我的面部轮廓，同时增添了一些急需的色彩。

sentences.en: Who knew?

sentences.en: My brother's advice, never pass up free food or drink.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥的建议是，永远不要错过免费的食物或饮料。

sentences.en: If you focus on the lesson, you'll continue to grow.
sentences.zh: 如果你专注于教训，你就会继续成长。

sentences.en: My name is Mel Foster, and I live in West Bloomfield, Michigan.
sentences.zh: 我叫梅尔·福斯特，住在密歇根州西布卢姆菲尔德。

sentences.en: A recent client, Bernie, shared this advice.
sentences.zh: 最近有一位客户伯尼分享了这样一个建议。

sentences.en: Never be afraid to enter into a new venture, but always be aware that you're going to pay a dumb tax.
sentences.zh: 永远不要害怕开始新的冒险，但要始终意识到你将付出愚蠢的学费。

sentences.en: You are going to try to figure out every possible roadblock that there is to your effort.
sentences.zh: 你会试图找出你努力过程中可能遇到的每一个障碍。

sentences.en: But when you actually get into it and actually pursue it, you're going to find there are problems that you never foresaw,
sentences.zh: 但当你真正进入其中并真正去追求时，你会发现有些问题是你从未预料到的，

sentences.en: and it's going to cost you money, and that's your dumb tax.
sentences.zh: 这会花掉你的钱，这就是你的愚蠢学费。

sentences.en: I had back trouble for most of the year.
sentences.zh: 我今年大部分时间都有背痛问题。

sentences.en: My physical therapist gave me some helpful exercises, but the best advice was a simple slogan, motion is lotion.
sentences.zh: 我的理疗师给了我一些有用的锻炼方法，但最好的建议是一个简单的口号，运动就是润滑剂。

sentences.en: The more active I am, the less my back bothers me.
sentences.zh: 我越活跃，我的背痛就越少困扰我。

sentences.en: Magic.

sentences.zh: 我叫伦·德塞萨。

sentences.en: I live in Dresher, Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 我住在宾夕法尼亚州德雷舍。

sentences.en: Well, the best advice I received in 2024
sentences.zh: 嗯，我在2024年收到的最好建议

sentences.en: I was talking about issues I was having in my relationship with my wife, and he said to me,
sentences.zh: 当时我在谈论我和妻子关系中遇到的问题，他对我说，

sentences.en: My friend shared that with me after the tornado that Hurricane Milton set off in my area, and I got a direct hit, and then the insanity of the election time, and now holidays.

sentences.en: And so my new term is just keep swimming.

sentences.en: And the best piece of advice I've got this year, and maybe ever, is from my friend Helen, who told me, don't borrow trouble.
sentences.zh: 我今年、甚至可能是有生以来收到最好的建议，来自我的朋友海伦，她告诉我，不要自找麻烦。

sentences.en: Annoyingly, I've shortened this to DBT.
sentences.zh: 讨厌的是，我把它缩写为了DBT。

sentences.en: And DBT is all about not getting yourself in bits or knots or catastrophizing about things in the future that are outside of your control.
sentences.zh: DBT的意思就是不要让自己陷入纠结、烦恼，或者对未来那些你无法控制的事情进行灾难化想象。

sentences.en: This is Nina Miller from Portland, Maine, reporting the most sage advice I received in 2024.
sentences.zh: 这是来自缅因州波特兰的尼娜·米勒，报告我收到的2024年最明智的建议。

sentences.en: It's pretty simple.
sentences.zh: 非常简单。

sentences.en: Practice makes better.
sentences.zh: 练习让事情变得更好。

sentences.en: For me, as a professional French horn player in an orchestra, playing the horn is really an imperfect instrument, yet we strive for perfection, which is unobtainable.
sentences.zh: 对我而言，作为管弦乐团的一名专业圆号手，吹奏圆号确实是一个不完美的乐器，然而我们都在追求完美，而这是无法企及的。

sentences.en: So having the permission to know that practice makes better was extremely liberating for me and just changed the whole way I look at my life, my work,
sentences.zh: 因此，获准知道练习能让事情变得更好，对我来说极其解放，彻底改变了我看待生活、工作的方式，

sentences.en: and the playing of my French horn.
sentences.zh: 以及我吹奏圆号的方式。

sentences.en: The best advice that I received this year was from my husband.
sentences.zh: 我今年收到的最好建议来自我的丈夫。

sentences.en: We are an old couple who have decades of harmony and conflict between us.
sentences.zh: 我们是一对老夫老妻，几十年来我们之间既有和谐也有冲突。

sentences.en: Whenever we are arguing, usually over something petty, like who left the light on or put a pink shirt in the whitewash, he will remind me that we will die soon.
sentences.zh: 每当我们在争吵时，通常是因为一些琐事，比如谁没关灯或者把粉色衬衫扔进白洗衣物里，他就会提醒我，我们很快就会死去的。

sentences.en: We are at that age where our conversations are peppered with sciatica and weak knee stories, and the next day is not guaranteed.
sentences.zh: 我们已经到了这个年龄，我们的谈话中充斥着坐骨神经痛和膝盖无力的故事，明天并不是有保证的。

sentences.en: So when we have flare-ups, he reminds me of our mortality and the importance of appreciating every given moment.
sentences.zh: 所以当我们爆发争吵时，他会提醒我我们的终有一死，以及珍惜每一个给定时刻的重要性。

sentences.en: My husband and I became first-time parents this year after quite a bout with infertility and had to go through several rounds of IVF.
sentences.zh: 我和丈夫在经历了一场不孕不育的抗争并经历了几轮试管婴儿后，今年第一次成为了父母。

sentences.en: So this child was very much a journey.
sentences.zh: 所以这个孩子真的是一段漫长的旅程。

sentences.en: And of course, people want to give parents, new parents, tons of advice, and so much of it is so kooky.
sentences.zh: 当然，人们想给父母，新父母，大量的建议，其中很多都是那么古怪。

sentences.en: You know, sleep when they sleep, or you must have this toy or this developmental thing.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们睡你跟着睡，或者你必须拥有这个玩具或这个发育玩具。

sentences.en: But I think the best piece of advice we've received was raise the child you have, not raise the child you want.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们收到的最好建议是，抚养你所拥有的孩子，而不是抚养你想要的孩子。
